page_note: Page contains the conclusion of a teaching about the Calling/Hearing, the soul as power of all fruits/seeds slain in the world, and the doctrine of names that resolve back into one unchanging name in the region of first substance. This is dense substratic cosmology — naming theology and the first contest. Then a chapter break (ornament + title 'Concerning the envy of Matter') and a new kephalaion opens with the standard apostolic frame ('Once again the Apostle said to his disciples'), introducing teaching that envy is the first nature that came-into-being in the worlds of Darkness. The fatigue score reflects the dialogue formula appearing only in the second half — but this is structural (chapter break) rather than editorial drift across one teaching unit. Substrate dominates throughout; only seg 27 is pure frame.
